subject.title: feat: add native inline widget support

question: Should native clients gain a caller-owned operator surface-refresh path, or should they advertise inline-widgets only while a refreshable node route is available?
rationale: The current node-only RPC leaves operator-origin widgets unrecoverable after expiry, while broadening refresh authorization changes a security-sensitive gateway contract that requires explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Add caller-owned refresh
options.body: Introduce an additive refresh method that rotates only the calling connection's own surface and make every native resolver refresh the route that actually failed.

options.title: Require a live node route
options.body: Advertise inline-widgets only when the client has a refreshable node Canvas route, preserving the existing authorization model at the cost of reduced availability.

options.title: Accept reconnect-only recovery
options.body: Ship the current design knowing operator-origin widgets can remain unavailable after capability expiry until the client reconnects.

recommendation.title: Add caller-owned refresh
recommendation.body: Introduce an additive refresh method that rotates only the calling connection's own surface and make every native resolver refresh the route that actually failed.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns both the original widget capability direction and the current cross-platform implementation, making them the best available owner for the refresh-boundary choice.
